title: Diagnostics
description: Every validation error and warning with what to do about it. Generated from the help table.
---

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask diagnostics-docs`; do not edit. -->

Errors (E) stop a Server or Route from working; warnings (W) point at something that probably is not what you meant. The Problems panel, `fauxfield validate` and the MCP `validate` tool print the same help line.

| Code | Kind | How to fix |
|---|---|---|
| `E001` | error | Fix the TOML syntax at the reported line; the file is skipped until it parses. |
| `E002` | error | Set `schema` to the version this Fauxfield writes, or update Fauxfield to open newer workspaces. |
| `E010` | error | Give each Server its own `id`; rename one of the duplicates. |
| `E011` | error | Give each Route its own `id` inside the Server; rename one of the duplicates. |
| `E012` | error | Give each Folder its own `id` inside the Server; rename one of the duplicates. |
| `E013` | error | Give each Response its own `id` inside the Route; rename one of the duplicates. |
| `E020` | error | Choose a free port in the Server settings, or stop the other Server that uses it. |
| `E021` | error | Set a port from 1 to 65535 in the Server settings. |
| `E030` | error | Point `folder` at an existing Folder id, or remove it to put the Route at the top level. |
| `E031` | error | Start the path with `/`, for example `/users/{id}`. |
| `E032` | error | Use one of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS or ANY. |
| `E033` | error | Check the `{name}` and `*` placeholders in the path pattern; each placeholder needs a name and no repeats. |
| `E034` | error | Set `match` to `exact`, `pattern` or `regex`. |
| `E035` | error | Fix the regular expression; test it in a regex tool, then paste it back. |
| `E040` | error | Set a status from 100 to 599. |
| `E041` | error | Keep either `body` or `body_file` on the Response and delete the other. |
| `E042` | error | Use a path inside the Workspace folder; `..` and absolute paths outside it are not allowed. |
| `E043` | error | Set `response_mode` to `default`, `sequence`, `random` or `weighted`, or remove it. |
| `E044` | error | Pick a Rule target from the list in the Rule editor (path, query, header, body, cookie, dataset). |
| `E045` | error | Pick a Rule operator from the list in the Rule editor. |
| `E046` | error | Fill in the key for this Rule target, for example the header name. |
| `E047` | error | Write the regex value as a string. |
| `E048` | error | Fix the JSONPath in the Rule key; it must start with `$`. |
| `E049` | error | Set `rules_logic` to `and` or `or`. |
| `E060` | error | Give each Environment its own name; rename one of the duplicates. |
| `E070` | error | Set the Route `kind` to `mock`, `crud` or `static`. |
| `E071` | error | Choose the Dataset a crud Route serves in the Route editor. |
| `E072` | error | Pick a Dataset that exists in this Server, or create it in the Datasets tab. |
| `E073` | error | Give each Dataset a unique, non-empty name. |
| `E074` | error | Set `id_strategy` to `uuid`, `increment` or `ulid`. |
| `E075` | error | Keep only one of `seed`, `seed_template` and `generator` on the Dataset. |
| `E076` | error | Fix the template error in the seed; the message shows the line and column. |
| `E077` | error | Break the cycle by removing one of the generator `ref` fields. |
| `E078` | error | Give each column a unique, non-empty name. |
| `E079` | error | Choose a column type from string, int, float, bool, datetime or json. |
| `E080` | error | Set requests to 1 or more in the rate limit settings. |
| `E081` | error | Write the window like `30s`, `1m` or `2h`. |
| `E082` | error | Use `ip`, `header:<name>` or `query:<name>` as the rate limit key. |
| `E083` | error | Write the delay as milliseconds (`300`) or a range (`200..800`). |
| `E084` | error | Pick a fault from the Response fault list. |
| `E085` | error | Set `fault_rate` between 0 and 1. |
| `E086` | error | Point the action at a Dataset that exists in this Server. |
| `E087` | error | Fix the action definition; the message names the field. |
| `E088` | error | Point the Rule at a Dataset that exists in this Server. |
| `E090` | error | Set `dir` to the folder to serve, relative to the Workspace. |
| `E091` | error | Start each template extension with a dot, for example `.tera`. |
| `E092` | error | Set the TLS mode to `dev-ca` or `files`. |
| `E093` | error | Set both `cert` and `key` when the TLS mode is `files`. |
| `E094` | error | Choose an `also_http_port` that differs from the Server port. |
| `E095` | error | Set the proxy mode to `fallback` or `passthrough`. |
| `E096` | error | Enter the upstream URL, or turn the proxy off. |
| `E097` | error | Write the upstream as a full URL starting with http:// or https://. |
| `E098` | error | Mark only one column as the primary key. |
| `E099` | error | Change the column default so it fits the column type. |
| `E100` | error | Make the primary key column match the Dataset `key`, or change the `key`. |
| `E101` | error | Use only list, get, create, update, patch and delete in `crud_ops`. |
| `E102` | error | Set the WebSocket mode to `echo`, `script` or `broadcast`. |
| `E103` | error | Set the trigger to `connect`, `interval` or `message`. |
| `E104` | error | Write `every` like `500ms`, `5s` or `1m`; the minimum is 10ms. |
| `E105` | error | Encode the binary message body as base64. |
| `E106` | error | Use a close code from 1000 to 4999. |
| `E107` | error | Set the message format to `compact`, `pretty` or `raw`. |
| `E108` | error | Give each Callback a unique id inside its Response. |
| `E109` | error | Enter the URL the Callback should call. |
| `E110` | error | Write the Callback URL starting with http:// or https://. |
| `E111` | error | Use a standard HTTP method for the Callback. |
| `E112` | error | Lower `retries` to the allowed maximum. |
| `W042` | warning | Create the file, fix the path, or remove `body_file`; the Response sends an empty body meanwhile. |
| `W043` | warning | Keep one default Response; clear `default` on the others. |
| `W044` | warning | Enable the default Response, or choose another default. |
| `W050` | warning | Rename the Server id to start with `srv_` (optional; this is a convention). |
| `W051` | warning | Move the Route above the one that shadows it, or make its path more specific. |
| `W052` | warning | Switch `match` to `pattern`, or ignore this if the path really contains braces. |
| `W060` | warning | Set `bandwidth_kbps` on the Server or a Network profile, or pick another fault. |
| `W070` | warning | Remove the Responses, or change the Route `kind` to `mock`. |
| `W071` | warning | Create the seed file, or fix its path; the Dataset starts empty until then. |
| `W072` | warning | Be aware that the action changes the Dataset file on disk. |
| `W090` | warning | List the allowed origins in CORS settings, or turn CORS off. |
| `W091` | warning | Turn off accepting invalid certificates before using the proxy with real services. |
| `W092` | warning | Set the Route to an http Route, or remove `proxy` and `pinned`. |
| `W093` | warning | Remove `when`, or change the trigger to `message`. |
| `W094` | warning | Pick a fault that keeps the connection open, or remove the Callbacks. |
